world.title: Spanish transport minister resigns days after deadly train crash
world.description: At least 69 people were killed and dozens injured in the collision south of the capital, Madrid.

world.title: Seven flights across Europe targeted by suspected bomb threats
world.description: Planes in Poland, Spain, Bulgaria and Italy have been checked for explosives following separate threats.

world.title: Binance says fake job interviews used as part of $6.3bn crypto hack
world.description: An engineer was contacted through a legitimate job-hunting platform and invited to bogus job interviews with fake company representatives, Binance says.

world.title: NTSB says crucial plane parts found three miles from Florida crash site
world.description: The NTSB said because the parts were found far from the accident site, they fell off before the crash.

world.title: Libya's top religious authority rules against wearing Nike clothes
world.description: The US company was named after the Greek goddess of victory, so the Dar al-Ifta said displaying its logo was unIslamic.

world.title: Europe on alert after supermarket freezers hit by cyber-attacks in 10 countries
world.description: Supermarkets have reported problems from Estonia and Sweden to Portugal and Italy and many retainers have been forced to discard food.

world.title: Death toll rises in Ukraine after Russia attacks aid centre, hospice and hospital
world.description: At least 38 people are killed in 24 hours and Ukraine's Volodymyr Zelensky warns dozens more could be trapped under rubble.

world.title: US strikes Iranian island ahead of midterm elections
world.description: US officials described the attacks on Qeshm Island as limited and defensive, according to CBS, the BBC's US partner.

world.title: Indian tourist killed after two helicopters collide near Everest base camp
world.description: The two aircraft crashed just metres from the ground after trying to land at the same spot.

world.title: Irish Olympian Ciara Mageean was a 'talented and inspirational human being'
world.description: The former European champion and two-time Olympic runner had been diagnosed with stage four bowel cancer.

world.title: Tenerife striker De Miguel dies after on-field collision
world.description: Tenerife forward Jesus de Miguel dies aged 30 after an on-field collision during a Spanish second-division match.

world.title: US urges Venezuela to release remaining political prisoners
world.description: The US secretary of state also discusses laying the groundwork for 'free, fair, and credible elections'.

world.title: Mining giant joins fight to stop killer toad march across Australia
world.description: Rio Tinto is jointly funding a A$28m "toad containment zoe" to protect the Pilbara region.

world.title: Asian Cup postponed in wake of attacks on Saudi Arabia
world.description: The 2027 Asian Cup in Saudi Arabia is postponed because of a series of deadly attacks on the host country.

world.title: Thousands of European troops to rehearse Ukraine deployment in event of peace
world.description: Western officials stress that any force sent to Ukraine would not take part in any offensive operations.

US.title: Rep. Katherine Clark says Democrats are on track to win control of the House tonight
US.description: NPR's Ailsa Chang speaks with House Democratic Whip Katherine Clark of Massachusetts about tonight's midterm elections.

US.title: Jon Ossoff wins reelection in Georgia, easily defeating Republican Mike Collins
US.description: A year ago, the Georgia Senate race was considered one of the cycle's marquee Senate showdowns. In the end, Ossoff easily defeated Collins.

US.title: Election Day 2026: Photos from around the country
US.description: Voters across the country are heading to the polls today to cast their ballots in the 2026 midterm elections.

US.title: What Democrats plan to prioritize if they retake the House
US.description: This election will determine control of Congress. Rep. Pete Aguilar, who represents California's 33rd Congressional District, shares how Democratic Party leaders are feeling as results come in.

US.title: Results: States decide on voter ID and redistricting ballot measures
US.description: Several states — including Alaska, Arizona, California and Nevada — are voting on changes to how their elections are run, including voter ID measures. Other states decide on redistricting proposals.

US.title: Legendary Photographer on getting that perfect election night picture
US.description: On election night, photographers will be in position, ready to snap history-making moments. It's something Pulitzer-prize-winner photographer David Hume Kennerly, has done for decades.

US.title: Connecticut bakers are bringing joy back to election day, one cake at a time
US.description: Nicole Sousa from the Old Statehouse in Hartford, CT, discusses the history of election cakes, a sweet civic tradition dating back to 1771.

US.title: Japan faces diplomatic dilemma amid joint pressure from nuclear neighbors
US.description: As the Ukraine war grinds on, ties between Russia and neighboring Japan are at their worst in decades. Tokyo wants more support from Washington, but some Japanese are concerned they may not get it.

US.title: Supreme Court leans toward LGBTQ exclusion for publicly funded Catholic preschools
US.description: The Supreme Court heard arguments Tuesday about Colorado's universal pre-K program and whether religious schools can bar certain families despite the state's anti-discrimination law.

US.title: A Binance engineer thought he was interviewing for a job. Then the hackers pounced
US.description: North Korean hackers pulled off the biggest cyber heist ever by duping a Binance engineer into thinking he was being recruited for a job, the crypto exchange says.
